_metadata.description: Library-scale attribute extraction delegated to music-tools, with resumable progress.

requirements.title: All audio understanding is delegated
requirements.description: This scenario computes no embeddings, stems, or musical attributes itself; every such value is obtained from music-tools. There is no local model execution path.

validation.notes: No direct model invocation exists; all attributes arrive via music-tools

requirements.title: First-pass decomposition is resumable and reports progress
requirements.description: Decomposing an existing library is a long batch operation that survives restart, reports meaningful progress and remaining work, and degrades to a partial but usable index rather than requiring completion before the product functions.

validation.notes: Batch resumes after restart; partial index is queryable

requirements.title: Expensive layers are lazy
requirements.description: Embeddings, tempo, key, loudness, and tags are computed for the whole library. Stem separation and notation are computed only on demand for a specific track, because library-wide production of those artifacts exceeds available disk.

validation.notes: No batch path requests stems or notation library-wide

requirements.title: Attribute search over the library
requirements.description: The listener can retrieve tracks by natural-language description and by structured attribute, and can ask for tracks similar to a given track — all before any preference model exists.

validation.notes: Text, attribute, and similarity retrieval work on a freshly indexed library
